description: This file defines the class BarStackedPlotAreaRenderer, which is responsible for rendering stacked bar plot areas in a charting library. It calculates bar positions and sizes, and determines if data points are within range.

classes.name: BarStackedPlotAreaRenderer
classes.description: A renderer for stacked bar plot areas, drawing bars one on top of another.

methods.name: CalcBars
methods.description: Calculates position, width, and height of each bar in all series for stacked bar chart rendering.

methods.name: IsDataInside
methods.description: Checks if a y-value is within the specified yMin and yMax range.
